bullets.text: 5G SA Launch in Manchester - **Virgin Media O2** activates 5G SA, enhancing connectivity for over 589,000 residents.
£100m Boost for Fractile - UK government supports **Fractile**'s expansion to enhance the AI hardware ecosystem.
AI in Networking Revolution - **Intent-Based Networking** simplifies network management using AI for automated configurations.
Vodafone's Private 5G Insights - **Vodafone Business** reports nearly 200 private 5G deployments, aiming for enterprise-friendly solutions.
AI-RRM Enhances Wi-Fi 7 - **AI-RRM** optimizes Wi-Fi networks in real-time, improving performance in dense environments.
WPA3 Security Challenges - **WPA3** adoption faces hurdles in multi-dwelling units, complicating security implementations.
Private 5G Deployment Issues - Space constraints hinder private 5G rollouts, prompting a shift to virtualized architectures.
Samsung's AI-Ready Networks - **Samsung** promotes AI integration in telecoms, enabling cost-effective, flexible network solutions.
BT Group Executive Changes - **BT Group** announces leadership changes at Openreach and BT International to drive growth.
6G's Sensing Infrastructure - Future **6G** networks may integrate sensing capabilities, transforming connectivity into situational awareness.
